title: Localization overflow
summary: Localized approved copy exceeds the capacity of its semantic region and pressures the build into clipping or illegal type reduction.

rendered_symptoms: approved copy clips or wraps beyond its region
body type falls below the configured minimum
not_sufficient_evidence: a longer translated string before rendering
a renderer warning without full-slide inspection

actions: split or reprioritize content with approval before rebuilding
verification: all approved copy renders inside its assigned region
stop_conditions: Output must not silently shorten copy
Output must not reduce type below approved minimums
